_readme: Homepage testimonials data. ONE source for every testimonials layout (assets/demo-testimonials.js reads it). Each review: name, initials, avatar (optional photo URL, a real member's own photo only; never stock or AI faces), role (optional), when (ISO date the review was given; shown as relative time), text, source (optional: Discord, email, X), sample (true = layout placeholder, shows a SAMPLE tag). The 12 entries below are SAMPLE text for layout only: replace them with real member reviews (with permission) and drop sample:true before the section goes live. No results, payouts, profits, win rates or prices in any review without the Owner's sign-off.

reviews.name: Marcus T.
reviews.text: Just finished the first level with Stryker. The models and risk management framework make everything so much easier to follow. Solid community as well. Highly recommend.

reviews.name: Chris L.
reviews.text: The indicators alone are worth it. Clean, accurate and save me so much time. The lessons actually explain the why, not just random setups.

reviews.name: Emily R.
reviews.text: Been trading for a while and this is the first place that actually teaches everything in a structured way. The journal and backtesting tool are game changers. Really happy I joined.

reviews.name: Daniel K.
reviews.text: Preparing for my first prop firm challenge with the Stryker models. The live sessions help a lot, and the community is super supportive. Thanks for building this!

reviews.name: Maya S.
reviews.text: The live sessions are next level. So much value just watching and asking questions. Everything is explained clearly and in a simple way. Highly recommend Stryker!

reviews.name: Ethan W.
reviews.text: Finally have a routine after joining Stryker. The structure, models and backtests made a huge difference. Wish I had this earlier.

reviews.name: Sarah M.
reviews.text: Amazing community and support. The live sessions really help put everything together. The education, indicators and journal are top tier.

reviews.name: Liam C.
reviews.text: Practised the IFVG model in the backtesting tool today and marked the setups exactly like in the lessons. Replaying it bar by bar also helps me stay disciplined.

reviews.name: Kevin T.
reviews.text: The content is super detailed but still easy to understand. The charts, examples and models make it simple to apply. Stryker is legit.

reviews.name: Isabella N.
reviews.text: I've tried a lot of trading education but this is different. Everything is well organized and actually useful. The backtesting app is a huge plus. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Riley J.
reviews.text: Just finished Chapter 4 and it finally clicked. The way it's explained is so much better than anything else I've tried. The community here is solid too.

reviews.name: Jordan P.
reviews.text: Great models, clean indicators and real examples. The live sessions and community keep me accountable. Easily the best trading education I've found.
